newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver prices fall on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver prices fall on low demand.

text.p: Indian silver prices lost recent gains on Friday due to demand resistance from industrial buyers and fresh arrivals of imported silver, dealers said.
About 500/700 kg of the imported silver arrived on Friday in the Bombay market. Gold prices on the other hand held steady at the improved level amid narrow price band and limited activity.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) remained steady at 58,600 rupees. They were up by 100 rupees on Thursday.
"Overall volumes remained low in early trade and whatever business reported was focussed on silver," one broker said.
